top_signals.title: Yen Is Vulnerable With Japan on Holiday After BOJ Disappoints
top_signals.summary: The yen is vulnerable to sharp moves and further declines over the next week, with a three-day holiday in Japan set to reduce trading liquidity and investors disappointed that the central bank didn’t offer stronger guidance on the pace of future interest rate hikes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
